annotation.summary: Someone would rather accept a large UNO penalty than do a simple thing.
annotation.visual: A card on the left offers an action or drawing 25 cards. A player on the right holds an enormous hand of cards.
annotation.mechanism: The wildly disproportionate penalty exposes stubbornness, pride, or refusal to concede an obvious point.
scenarios: Refuse to admit that the cache caused a bug after hours of debugging
Keep doing repetitive work rather than learn one shortcut
Accept extra work rather than apologize
roles: Right player: person accepting the penalty

examples.why: The person pays a ridiculous cost to avoid admitting the simple answer.

avoid: Make the refused action clear; the joke depends on choosing the penalty instead.
annotation.basis: Creative interpretation based on inspected source media; not a verified account of historical origin.
